title: Chromatic PSF — monochromatic baseline (single wavelength)
notes: Single-wavelength (mono) PSF baseline; poly variant raises psf_n_wavelengths. GUI baseline shortens integration to 1 ms (well ~52%) and uses a well-matched gain (32 e-/DN) so the 14-bit ADC no longer clips at the runner's 2 ms point (CU-170).
